decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft preference because the evidence ranges from tentative interest to a direct requirement.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels with free breakfast included, while verifying inclusion when it is unclear.
decisions.condition: When evaluating or booking a hotel.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize hotels with free breakfast when available, and verify whether breakfast is included if the listing is unclear.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not reject an otherwise suitable hotel solely because free breakfast is unavailable unless the user makes it mandatory for the current booking; do not infer requirements about breakfast type or quality.
decisions.name: prefer_included_hotel_breakfast
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.rationale: Repeated evidence across three hotel conversations supports a recurring preference for included free breakfast. The varying strength of the utterances supports retaining it as a soft default rather than an absolute requirement.

decisions.boundary_condition: Do not infer that the pool or hot tub must be indoor or outdoor, and do not incorporate unrelated trip-specific details such as destination, dates, price, or beach proximity.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer leisure hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise facility.
decisions.condition: When choosing or evaluating a hotel for a leisure stay.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize hotels offering the full pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise facility bundle, and clearly identify any missing element.
decisions.exception_condition: If no otherwise suitable hotel offers all three amenities, present close matches and explicitly state which amenity is absent.
decisions.name: hotel_recreation_and_exercise_amenities
decisions.preference_value: Prefers hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise facility.
decisions.rationale: Three conversations consistently support a recurring preference for the combined pool, hot tub, and exercise-facility amenity bundle. Indoor versus outdoor is not stable enough to include as part of the policy.
